hero.title: Temozón, Birthplace of Smoked Meats
hero.subtitle: Since 1969, our family has preserved the Yucatecan tradition of artisanal smoking. Secret recipes passed down through generations, cooked with charcoal and patience.

about.metaDescription: Discover the history of Temozonia, Yucatecan tradition in artisanal smoked meats.
about.ekBalamDescription: Inspired by the majesty of Ek Balam, we honor the ancestral traditions of Yucatecan smoking.
about.visitTemozonSubtitle: Come see our home and taste our products
about.traditionDescription: Each generation inherits the fire, the time, and the secret of smoking. In Temozón we don't just cook meat: we preserve a way of life that has endured for over 50 years.

section1.subtitle: The Origin
section1.text: Temozón, which in Mayan means 'place of the whirlwind', is a peaceful community in eastern Yucatán. Over five decades ago, around 1969, several natives of this village began experimenting with smoking techniques that distinguish us to this day.

section2.subtitle: Family Tradition
section2.text: What began as a family enterprise is now a legacy we preserve with pride. More than 18 butcher shops on Temozón's main street keep this tradition alive, each with its own identity but sharing the same commitment to quality.

section3.subtitle: The Secret
section3.text: There are recipes that no family reveals. The perfect marinade, the exact ingredients, the precise cooking time... These are secrets we guard jealously and that make every bite of our smoked meats unique.

selection.title: Selection
selection.desc: Every morning, from very early, we select the freshest meat from trusted local suppliers.

marinade.title: Secret Marinade
marinade.desc: We prepare the meat with our secret family recipe, a perfect combination of spices and Yucatecan flavors.

smoking.title: Charcoal Smoking
smoking.desc: We cook slowly over charcoal, allowing the smoke to infuse every fiber of meat with unparalleled flavor.

quality.title: Quality Control
quality.desc: Each piece is carefully reviewed to ensure it meets our highest standards.

tradition.title: Tradition
tradition.desc: We honor the ancestral smoking techniques inherited from our grandparents.

community.title: Community
community.desc: Temozón is our home. We support local commerce and the economy of our region.

heritage.title: Cultural Heritage
heritage.subtitle: More than smoked meats, we are guardians of a tradition
heritage.church: Visit the Church of San Antonio de Padua and the temple of San Román, built in the 18th century, historical witnesses of our community.
heritage.ekbalam: Just 14 kilometers from Temozón is Ek Balam, a majestic Mayan archaeological site that is part of our cultural identity.
